_comment: Curated catalogue of public artifacts on files.nordicsemi.com.
Anonymous callers can list Artifactory repositories and each repository root,
but deeper listing requires authentication (api/storage below the root returns
404 and ?list&deep=1 returns 403). Downloads by known path are open, so the
download tree is curated here rather than crawled. Paths are relative to
https://files.nordicsemi.com/artifactory/ and are verified at ingest time.

groups.title: nrfutil
groups.notes: The unified Nordic command line tool. Install nrfutil first, then use 'nrfutil install <command>' to add device, toolchain-manager and other subcommands.
